dormition-theotokos-norfolk.assessment: Dormition of the Theotokos (Norfolk) is an OCA parish serving Hampton Roads under Fr. John Cox. Named for the Dormition (Aug 15) feast — the Eastern Orthodox analog to the Catholic Assumption. Eastern Orthodox theosis soteriology remains the red-flag divergence from sola fide; Marian/Theotokos devotion is especially prominent given the parish patronage.

downtown-cornerstone-acts29-seattle-wa.assessment: Downtown Cornerstone Church is an Acts 29 church plant in downtown Seattle led by Adam Sinnett, planted in 2009. Operating in the same city where Mars Hill Church collapsed in 2014, DCC represents a healthier post-Driscoll Acts 29 expression. The church is committed to gospel-centered, expository preaching, complementarian polity, and urban mission. For a man in greater Seattle seeking a complementarian church with a downtown footprint, DCC is a credible recommendation. Verify current elder board and ministry culture directly.
